What does shallowRef do compared to ref?
```js
const deep = ref({ n: 1 }); const shallow = shallowRef({ n: 1 })
const seen = []
watch(deep, () => seen.push('deep'), { deep: true })
watch(shallow, () => seen.push('shallow'), { deep: true })
deep.value.n++; shallow.value.n++
await nextTick()
console.log(seen.join(','))
shallow.value = { n: 5 }
await nextTick()
console.log(seen.join(','))
```
questions.explain: A shallowRef tracks only replacing .value, not mutations inside the object. Verified by running it with Vue 3.5 in Node (server renderer for templates; the SSR hydration comment markers are stripped for readability).

```js
n.value = 1; await nextTick()
scope.stop()
n.value = 2; await nextTick()
console.log(log.join(','))
```

questions.q: What is the right place to fetch data for a view?
options: A composable returning data, error and loading refs, called from setup

questions.q: A route works when navigated to but 404s on refresh in production. Why?
options: The server has no fallback to index.html for history-mode routes

questions.q: What is Pinia's role?
options: Shared state outside components, with actions and getters

questions.q: How do you test a Pinia store in isolation?
options: Create a fresh Pinia per test and call actions directly

questions.q: What does hydration mean in SSR?
options: The client attaching reactivity and listeners to server-rendered HTML

questions.q: What commonly causes hydration mismatches?
options: Rendering different output on server and client, for example Date.now() or window during render

questions.q: Why is a module-level store dangerous in SSR?
options: State leaks between requests; create a new app and store per request

questions.q: Which assets can be cached forever in production?
options: Hashed build assets (the file name changes with content)

questions.q: How do you secure a Vue app against XSS?
options: Avoid v-html with user input, sanitise when needed, and set a Content-Security-Policy

questions.q: What proves a Vue app is production-ready?
options: CI with tests and accessibility checks, performance budgets, error monitoring and a rollback plan

challenges.title: A habit-tracker composable with persistence
challenges.prompt: Write useHabits, a composable that restores habits from a storage object, adds (with trimming and duplicate checks), toggles days immutably, summarises today's progress, computes streaks and saves changes with a deep watcher. A fake storage object stands in for localStorage so it runs in Node; only Vue's reactivity package is used, no DOM or components.
challenges.expected:
add Read: true
add read (dup): false
add Run: true
add empty: false
1/2 done today | streak(Read) = 3 | streak(Run) = 0
storage writes (batched by the watcher): 1
restored: Read(3), Run(0)
after delete: Read
corrupt storage -> 0 habits
challenges.explain: Because the watcher is flushed asynchronously, the five synchronous edits cause a single storage write. Restoring runs through try/catch so corrupt data falls back to an empty list. Verified by running it with Vue 3.5 in Node.

challenges.title: Server-render a product list with props, slots and provide/inject
challenges.prompt: Build ProductList, ProductCard and PriceView components and render the page to HTML on the server with createSSRApp and renderToString. Use props with defaults, named slots with fallback content, a computed filter and sort, and provide/inject for a money formatter. The hydration comment markers are stripped from the printed HTML; note the id attribute, which falls through from v-bind because it is not a declared prop.
challenges.expected:
• Notebook $4.50
  • Notepad $3.00
  • Pen $1.50gone
  • Notepad $3.00
  • Notebook $4.50

No products match "zzz"
challenges.explain: v-bind="p" passes every product field; declared props are consumed and the undeclared id becomes an attribute on the card's root element (attribute fallthrough). The scoped badge slot replaces the fallback only for sold-out items, and an empty filter shows the empty state. Verified by running it with Vue 3.5 in Node.
